editorial: Prepare yourself for a claustrophobic descent into the psyche of a man blinded by his own ambition. You will feel the frantic energy of Josh Safdie's direction as it transforms a simple pursuit of greatness into a high-stakes psychological war. The visceral tension in every frame makes the atmospheric dread almost tactile. You should dive in if you crave a character study that prioritizes raw, nervous energy over traditional plot beats.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of high-anxiety cinema and obsessive protagonists.
